title: Installation
subtitle: Get started with Qortex
description: Install qortex using your preferred package manager and set up your project.
content: Install qortex using your preferred package manager. Choose the package that fits your needs:

callouts.title: Choose Your Package
callouts.content: Install qortex-core OR qortex-react - not both! qortex-react includes all core APIs.

sections.title: For React Projects
sections.content: If you're using React, install qortex-react (includes all core APIs):

code.code:
# npm
npm install qortex-react

# yarn
yarn add qortex-react

# pnpm
pnpm add qortex-react

sections.title: For Non-React Projects
sections.content: If you're using vanilla JS, Vue, or other frameworks, install qortex-core:

code.code:
# npm
npm install qortex-core

# yarn
yarn add qortex-core

# pnpm
pnpm add qortex-core
